dedupe_keys.name: a 14 day ground truth dataset for fdi attack detection in a smart microgrid cyber physical testbed

description: A University of Genoa team publishes a 14-day, one-second smart-microgrid state-estimation dataset. Zenodo provides a large CSV and a baseline measurement-Jacobian file under CC BY 4.0. The linked code repository describes a 0.4-kV radial grid with photovoltaic supply, battery storage and loads. Its generator solves power flow, estimates state from simulated PMU measurements and records residuals and a chi-squared bad-data statistic for about 1.2 million steps. These series can test false-data-injection detection and cyber-physical resilience scenarios. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this deposited ground truth. Coverage is a synthetic testbed, not measured utility traffic or actual attacks. A limitation is that detector performance depends on the assumed topology, noise and state-estimation model. The CSV filename calls it a spatial graph, but repository documentation identifies it as the long time-step table; file contents were not inspected. Neither dataset generation nor attack-detection performance was reproduced.
